description: UK Insolvency Check (Companies House + The Gazette). Check UK companies for insolvency by company number (e.g. 00445790, SC210223) or exact company name, up to 200 per run: Companies House insolvency cases and company status plus The Gazette notices (winding-up petitions, liquidation, administration). One row per company with a verdict - in_liquidation, in_administration, in_receivership, voluntary_arrangement, moratorium, insolvency_proceedings, winding_up_petition (a petition published in the last 12 months before any appointment, which Companies House does not show), dissolved_after_insolvency, past_insolvency or no_insolvency_found - with case dates, petitioner company, petition and hearing dates, court, case reference and links to the official notices. Practitioner names are not returned. no_insolvency_found means neither register holds an insolvency record for the company; a name matching several companies is returned as ambiguous with the candidates, a number not in the register as not_found, and a register that did not answer as NOT checked (unknown, not clear) - none of these is charged. checkComplete=false lists why a row may be partial. Prefer the company number. No API key. Advanced fields beyond this schema are also accepted (regdata_describe lists them).

companies.description: UK company numbers (e.g. 00445790, SC210223) or exact company names, one per line, up to 200 per run. Numbers and names can be mixed. A company number is the most precise check; a name is used only when exactly one company in Companies House matches it, otherwise the candidates are listed.
companies.title: Companies to check

includeGazette.description: On (default): also search The Gazette for winding-up petitions and corporate insolvency notices about each company. Off: Companies House only (faster, but a winding-up petition before any appointment is not visible there).
includeGazette.title: Search The Gazette

maxItems.description: Optional cap on billed dataset items returned.

maxNoticesPerCompany.description: The most Gazette notices returned for one company, newest first. A long liquidation can have dozens of meeting and dividend notices.
maxNoticesPerCompany.title: Max Gazette notices per company

name: regdata_uk_insolvency
